title: Learning to Interact and Direct: Co-Evolving Video Director Agents
title_zh: 学习交互与执导：共同演化的视频导演智能体

paragraphs.en: 提出LIT共同演化框架，让导演智能体、模拟用户与元智能体协同进化，显著提升视频制作与交互能力。 Video director agents orchestrate multistage production to realize users' creative visions. Emerging research on their self-evolution advances screenplay planning effectively. However, the mutual reinforcement between directing and user interaction remains largely overlooked. Improved interaction clarifies user intent and informs workflow refinement, while more reliable execution shifts collaboration from troubleshooting to creative decisions. To this end, we introduce LIT (Learning to Interact and DirecT), a framework comprises a director agent, a simulated user, and a meta engineer. Simulated user assigns creative tasks to probe the director's weaknesses, while the meta engineer uses the task traces to revise the director's interaction and production strategy. Although this approach can address discovered interaction and production issues, it still relies on passive attribution by the meta agent. This limits its ability to adapt to broader user interaction patterns and production techniques. To solve this problem, we equip LIT with a co-evolution paradigm. The meta agent proactively learns external knowledge, thereby improving its ability to discover problems and propose solutions. The meta agent, simulated user, and director together form an evolutionary closed loop, collaboratively enhances the system's directing and interaction capabilities. Across the Test and OOD Test splits, LIT improves production and Interaction scores by 19.1% and 32.0%, respectively, relative to the initial pipeline. Controlled ablations reveal the correlation between improvements in production and interaction, where the co-evolution mechanism further encourage directing skill and interaction mode exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 提出LIT共同演化框架，让导演智能体、模拟用户与元智能体协同进化，显著提升视频制作与交互能力。视频导演智能体编排多阶段制作流程，以实现用户的创意愿景。 关于其自我演化的新兴研究有效推进了剧本规划。 然而，执导与用户交互之间的相互增强在很大程度上被忽视了。 改进的交互能澄清用户意图并为工作流优化提供依据，而更可靠的执行则使协作从问题排查转向创意决策。 为此，我们提出LIT（Learning to Interact and DirecT），该框架由一个导演智能体、一个模拟用户和一个元工程师组成。 模拟用户向导演智能体分配创意任务以探查其弱点，而元工程师则利用任务轨迹来修订导演智能体的交互与制作策略。 尽管这一方法能够解决所发现的交互与制作问题，但它仍依赖于元智能体的被动归因。 这限制了其适应更广泛的用户交互模式和制作技术的能力。 为解决这一问题，我们为LIT引入了共同演化范式。 元智能体主动学习外部知识，从而提升其发现问题并提出解决方案的能力。 元智能体、模拟用户与导演智能体共同构成一个演化闭环，协作提升系统的执导与交互能力。 在Test和OOD Test两个划分上，相对于初始流水线，LIT分别将制作得分与交互得分提升了19.1%和32.0%。 受控消融实验揭示了制作能力与交互能力提升之间的关联，其中共同演化机制进一步促进了执导技能与交互模式的探索。
